summary: Today’s tape looks cautiously risk-on in crypto, with Bitcoin and Ethereum still constructive while several altcoins are showing selective momentum. Macro sentiment is mixed: equities are uneven, gold is firm, and Brent crude is supported, while trader commentary leans toward rotating into high-beta alts and short-term breakout names.
